test_title: PYST 7: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 03 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: SXYU is related to TYZV in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, GLMI is related to HMNJ. To which of the following is QVWS related to, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef1a08d1ac261dc312fe06bf091df2a759e46479c435e13d4eef66d50fd21097.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, 'SXYU is related to TYZV'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60e1a2a4358a90ad14169fc4fb8bd5bfb6fb3bafa860f4b154e1015f9fdb80f0.png] 

For, 'GLMI is related to HMNJ'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/93fb9cbc3a499b7a82c68395fab3ed89e1f2d4bae98c12fcc46d2245a5feecfc.png] 

Similarly, for '**QVWS**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7572dc2b08dbbe6cc879f7a507cda037b7cb2fd57561d4224a3892690ecefe8.png] 

So, 'QVWS' will be related to '**RWXT**'

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
